Research experience & skills

Observations
LBT/LUCI near-infrared spectroscopy; DESI and SDSS spectroscopy; Subaru/HSC imaging; JWST/NIRCam science analysis.
Analysis
Optical and near-infrared data reduction; PSF-aware image and spectrum decomposition; stellar-population and emission-line modeling; reverberation-mapping and single-epoch mass calibration.
Inference
Forward modeling, mock-data and injection-recovery validation, calibrated uncertainties, and neural networks for astronomical spectra.
Computing
Python, NumPy, SciPy, Astropy, PyTorch, FSPS, Matplotlib; reproducible HPC workflows.
Developing interests
NIRSpec IFU science planning, Euclid morphology, and spatially resolved quasar environments.
